Planned extraction targets and where to find them:
- Invoice.Date: look for "Datum" header on page 1 (near top-right).
- Sender.VatId: look for "VAT Registration n°" / "ATU..." on page 1 and repeated IBAN block.
- GrandTotal.Amount: look for final gross total in the VAT summary table / totals section (page 1 shows totals and a gross amount).
- Vat.Rate / Net.Amount / Vat.Amount: extract VAT group rows from the VAT summary table (columns showing MwSt.-% , MwSt.-€ , Wert netto / Gesamtsumme netto / brutto). There is a single VAT group 10,00% with corresponding net and VAT amounts.
- Net.Amount: take the net total corresponding to the VAT group (preserve decimals).
- Vat.Amount: take the VAT euro amount corresponding to that group (preserve decimals).
Notes and rules applied:
- No inference: only explicit text values will be used.
- Preserve decimal formatting as in document.
- VAT rate will be returned without the "%" symbol.
- If any target value is not explicitly present, it will be left empty.
